style.styleTitle: Homcom 3ft Prelit Artificial Christmas Tree With Led Lights
style.toneOfVoice: This holiday season, spend more time celebrating and less time maintaining and cleaning up with this Tall Pre-lit, Artificial Christmas Tree from HOMCOM. With this particular model, built in fiber optics and LED light that complement each other in a beautiful sparkling display to give off an authentic holiday feel. Each fiber optic branch and LED light create a striking lighting display that really makes this tree the centerpiece of the holiday. 3ft tall artificial Christmas tree in a realistic tree style; Snow dipped design, ends are painted white, add winter atmosphere; Multi-colored fiber optic and LED lighting built light into the tree provides a dazzlingly display ; Beautiful pre-set light patterns, flashing modes for creative holiday twinkling ; Realistic branches give a full and lush look to the tree; Base is detachable and foldable for easy storage; Sturdy base for better stability; Branches is flame retardant, to ensure secured; In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips; Tree Colour: Green, White; LED Lighting Colour: RGB Colour; Material: PVC, Steel; Cord length: 1.8m; Input: 100-240V, 50/60Hz; Dimensions: F48 x 90H cm. Tree height: 3ft; Branch tips: 90; Lighting count: 12 LED lights; Output: DC 12V/6W; Item label: 02-0769; Dimensions: F60 x 120H cm. Tree height: 4ft; Branch tips: 130; Lighting count: 16 LED lights; Output: DC 12V/3.6W; Item label: 02-0770.
